clips.send: Multiply 2 cubed times 2 to the power of 4 . Write out the factors: 3 twos and 4 twos. Together that is 7 twos, so 2 cubed times 2 to the power of 4 equals 2 to the power of 3 plus 4 equals 2 to the power of 7 . Same base: add the exponents.
clips.text: Multiply 2 3 times 2 4. Write out the factors: 3 twos and 4 twos. Together that is 7 twos, so 2 3 times 2 4 = 2 3+4 = 2 7. Same base: add the exponents.

clips.send: Tiny numbers work the same way in reverse. A human hair is about 0.00007 m thick. Hop the point right 5 places to land after the 7: 7 times 10 to the power of negative5 m. Hops to the right give a negative exponent.
clips.text: Tiny numbers work the same way in reverse. A human hair is about 0.00007 m thick. Hop the point right 5 places to land after the 7: 7 times 10 -5 m. Hops to the right give a negative exponent.

clips.send: Divide 2 to the power of 6 over 2 squared . Each 2 on the bottom cancels one 2 on top. Four twos survive: 2 to the power of 6 over 2 squared equals 2 to the power of 6 minus 2 equals 2 to the power of 4 equals 16 . Same base: subtract the exponents.
clips.text: Divide over 2 6 2 2 . Each 2 on the bottom cancels one 2 on top. Four twos survive: over 2 6 2 2 = 2 6-2 = 2 4 = 16. Same base: subtract the exponents.

clips.send: Now follow a pattern. Going down the list, the exponent drops by 1 and the value is divided by 10. Keep going past 10 to the power of 1 : next comes 10 to the power of 0 equals 1 , then 10 to the power of negative1 equals 1 over 10 , then 10 to the power of negative2 equals 1 over 100 .
clips.text: Now follow a pattern. Going down the list, the exponent drops by 1 and the value is divided by 10. Keep going past 10 1: next comes 10 0 = 1, then 10 -1 = over 1 10 , then 10 -2 = over 1 100 .

clips.send: So for any nonzero base: a to the power of 0 equals 1 and a to the power of negativen equals 1 over a to the power of n . The quotient rule agrees: 2 cubed over 2 cubed equals 2 to the power of 3 minus 3 equals 2 to the power of 0 , and anything divided by itself is 1. Example: 2 to the power of negative3 equals 1 over 2 cubed equals 1 over 8 .
clips.text: So for any nonzero base: a 0 = 1 and a -n = over 1 a n . The quotient rule agrees: over 2 3 2 3 = 2 3-3 = 2 0, and anything divided by itself is 1. Example: 2 -3 = over 1 2 3 = over 1 8 .

clips.send: An exponent counts repeated multiplication. A 3-by-3 square has 3 times 3 equals 3 squared equals 9 tiles; a 3-by-3-by-3 cube has 3 times 3 times 3 equals 3 cubed equals 27 blocks. In 3 to the power of 4 , 3 is the base and 4 is the exponent.
clips.text: An exponent counts repeated multiplication. A 3-by-3 square has 3 times 3 = 3 2 = 9 tiles; a 3-by-3-by-3 cube has 3 times 3 times 3 = 3 3 = 27 blocks. In 3 4, 3 is the base and 4 is the exponent.

clips.send: Beyond three dimensions we can no longer draw a shape, but we can still count: 2 to the power of 5 equals 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 equals 32 . Each extra factor of 2 doubles the result.
clips.text: Beyond three dimensions we can no longer draw a shape, but we can still count: 2 5 = 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 = 32. Each extra factor of 2 doubles the result.

clips.send: A power of a power: (2 cubed) squared means two groups of 2 cubed . That is 3 times 2 equals 6 twos: (2 cubed) squared equals 2 to the power of 3 times 2 equals 2 to the power of 6 equals 64 . Multiply the exponents.
clips.text: A power of a power: (2 3) 2 means two groups of 2 3. That is 3 times 2 = 6 twos: (2 3) 2 = 2 3 times 2 = 2 6 = 64. Multiply the exponents.

clips.send: Scientific notation tames huge numbers. The Sun is about 150 000 000 km away. Hop the decimal point left until just one nonzero digit is in front of it: 8 hops, so the distance is 1.5 times 10 to the power of 8 km.
clips.text: Scientific notation tames huge numbers. The Sun is about 150 000 000 km away. Hop the decimal point left until just one nonzero digit is in front of it: 8 hops, so the distance is 1.5 times 10 8 km.

clips.send: Worked example: how many times farther away is the Sun ( 1.5 times 10 to the power of 8 km) than the Moon ( 3.8 times 10 to the power of 5 km)? Divide the front numbers and subtract the exponents: 1.5 over 3.8 times 10 to the power of 8 minus 5 is about 0.4 times 10 cubed equals 400 . About 400 times!
clips.text: Worked example: how many times farther away is the Sun (1.5 times 10 8 km) than the Moon (3.8 times 10 5 km)? Divide the front numbers and subtract the exponents: over 1.5 3.8 times 10 8-5 approx 0.4 times 10 3 = 400. About 400 times!

clips.send: 超过三维就画不出形状了，但我们仍然可以数： 2的5次方 等于 2 乘 2 乘 2 乘 2 乘 2 等于 32 。每多乘一个 2，结果就翻一倍。
clips.text: 超过三维就画不出形状了，但我们仍然可以数：2 5 = 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 times 2 = 32。每多乘一个 2，结果就翻一倍。

clips.send: 指数表示重复相乘的次数。3 乘 3 的正方形有 3 乘 3 等于 3的平方 等于 9 块；3 乘 3 乘 3 的正方体有 3 乘 3 乘 3 等于 3的立方 等于 27 块。在 3的4次方 中，3 是底数，4 是指数，读作“3 的 4 次方”。
clips.text: 指数表示重复相乘的次数。3×3 的正方形有 3 times 3 = 3 2 = 9 块；3×3×3 的正方体有 3 times 3 times 3 = 3 3 = 27 块。在 3 4 中，3 是底数，4 是指数，读作“3 的 4 次方”。

clips.send: 很小的数反过来做。一根头发约 0.00007 米粗。把小数点向右移 5 位，落到 7 的后面： 7 乘 10的负5次方 米。向右移动，指数就是负数。
clips.text: 很小的数反过来做。一根头发约 0.00007 米粗。把小数点向右移 5 位，落到 7 的后面：7 times 10 -5 米。向右移动，指数就是负数。

clips.send: 科学记数法可以驯服很大的数。太阳离我们约 150 000 000 千米。把小数点向左移动，直到它前面只剩一个非零数字：移了 8 位，所以距离是 1.5 乘 10的8次方 千米。
clips.text: 科学记数法可以驯服很大的数。太阳离我们约 150 000 000 千米。把小数点向左移动，直到它前面只剩一个非零数字：移了 8 位，所以距离是 1.5 times 10 8 千米。

clips.send: 计算 2的立方 乘 2的4次方 。把因数写出来：3 个 2 和 4 个 2，合在一起是 7 个 2，所以 2的立方 乘 2的4次方 等于 2的3 加 4次方 等于 2的7次方 。同底数幂相乘，指数相加。
clips.text: 计算 2 3 times 2 4。把因数写出来：3 个 2 和 4 个 2，合在一起是 7 个 2，所以 2 3 times 2 4 = 2 3+4 = 2 7。同底数幂相乘，指数相加。

clips.send: 所以对任意不为 0 的底数： a的0次方 等于 1 , a的负n次方 等于 a的n次方分之1 。除法法则也同意： 2的立方分之2的立方 等于 2的3 减 3次方 等于 2的0次方 ，而一个数除以它自己等于 1。例如 2的负3次方 等于 2的立方分之1 等于 8分之1 。
clips.text: 所以对任意不为 0 的底数：a 0 = 1,a -n = over 1 a n 。除法法则也同意： over 2 3 2 3 = 2 3-3 = 2 0，而一个数除以它自己等于 1。例如 2 -3 = over 1 2 3 = over 1 8 。

clips.send: 计算 2的平方分之2的6次方 。分母里的每个 2 都和分子里的一个 2 约掉，剩下 4 个 2: 2的平方分之2的6次方 等于 2的6 减 2次方 等于 2的4次方 等于 16 。同底数幂相除，指数相减。
clips.text: 计算 over 2 6 2 2 。分母里的每个 2 都和分子里的一个 2 约掉，剩下 4 个 2: over 2 6 2 2 = 2 6-2 = 2 4 = 16。同底数幂相除，指数相减。

clips.send: 现在顺着规律往下走。每往下一行，指数减 1，数值除以 10。越过 10的1次方 继续：接下来是 10的0次方 等于 1 ，然后 10的负1次方 等于 10分之1 ，再然后 10的负2次方 等于 100分之1 。
clips.text: 现在顺着规律往下走。每往下一行，指数减 1，数值除以 10。越过 10 1 继续：接下来是 10 0 = 1，然后 10 -1 = over 1 10 ，再然后 10 -2 = over 1 100 。

clips.send: 例题：太阳（ 1.5 乘 10的8次方 千米）比月球（ 3.8 乘 10的5次方 千米）远多少倍？前面的数相除，指数相减： 3.8分之1.5 乘 10的8 减 5次方 约等于 0.4 乘 10的立方 等于 400 。大约 400 倍！
clips.text: 例题：太阳（1.5 times 10 8 千米）比月球（3.8 times 10 5 千米）远多少倍？前面的数相除，指数相减： over 1.5 3.8 times 10 8-5 approx 0.4 times 10 3 = 400。大约 400 倍！

clips.send: 幂的乘方： (2的立方)的平方 表示两组 2的立方 ，一共 3 乘 2 等于 6 个 2: (2的立方)的平方 等于 2的3 乘 2次方 等于 2的6次方 等于 64 。指数相乘。
clips.text: 幂的乘方：(2 3) 2 表示两组 2 3，一共 3 times 2 = 6 个 2:(2 3) 2 = 2 3 times 2 = 2 6 = 64。指数相乘。
